statements.english: " I'm just flirting , no big deal ."
statements.chinese: 我只是在调情而已，没什么大不了的。

statements.english: But the guy is thinking
statements.chinese: 但这家伙却在想，

statements.english: " Finally ! Somebody who wants to sleep with me !"
statements.chinese: 终于！有人想和我睡觉了！

who.definition: 关系代词（引导定语从句）

wants.definition: want（第三人称单数）: 想要

statements.english: No way !
statements.chinese: 不可能！

statements.english: It's true
statements.chinese: 确实如此。

statements.english: Well that's pathetic !
statements.chinese: 这也太可悲了！

statements.english: Again true
statements.chinese: 再次为真。

statements.english: And this goes for all guys ?
statements.chinese: 所有男人都这样吗？

goes.definition: go（第三人称单数）: 适用于

statements.english: All guys that are awake
statements.chinese: 所有醒着的家伙们。

statements.english: Then we go to sleep
statements.chinese: 然后我们就寝

statements.english: and then all the guys from the other end of the world
statements.chinese: 然后是来自世界另一端的那些家伙

statements.english: wake up and behave the exact same way
statements.chinese: 醒来后表现得和往常一模一样。

statements.english: All right , it's another commercial ; I still haven't told her !
statements.chinese: 好吧，又是个广告；我还是没告诉她！

statements.english: Joey ! This is like the last commercial
statements.chinese: Joey！这就像是最后的广告了。

statements.english: You've got like ten minutes left !
statements.chinese: 你只剩大约十分钟了！

statements.english: I know , I know ! What am I going to do ?
statements.chinese: 我知道，我知道！我该怎么办？

am.definition: be（现在时第一人称单数）: 是

statements.english: No ! You are not gonna run out and leave her here !
statements.chinese: 不！你不能就这样跑掉把她丢在这里！

statements.english: Yeah , all right
statements.chinese: 好的，没问题。

statements.english: Joey !
statements.chinese: Joey！

statements.english: Uh , Joey is gonna be right back
statements.chinese: 呃，Joey马上就回来。

statements.english: Right back !
statements.chinese: 马上回来！

statements.english: Meanwhile , let's-let's-let's talk about you
statements.chinese: 与此同时，咱们——咱们——咱们聊聊你吧。

statements.english: So , you're old and small
statements.chinese: 所以，你又老又矮小。

statements.english: Did you find it ?
statements.chinese: 你找到了吗？

Did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

statements.english: The earring ? No
statements.chinese: 耳环？不是。

statements.english: But look , I found my sunglasses under the couch !
statements.chinese: 但是你看，我在沙发底下找到了我的太阳镜！

statements.english: I've been looking for these since like last summer
statements.chinese: 我从去年夏天就开始找这些东西了。

been.definition: be（过去分词）: 构成现在完成进行时

statements.english: Okay , those are my sunglasses , you borrowed them from me
statements.chinese: 好的，那是我的太阳镜，你从我这儿借走的。

statements.english: Okay , calm down , here they are
statements.chinese: 好了，冷静点，东西在这儿。

statements.english: Phoebe !
statements.chinese: Phoebe！

statements.english: What are we going to do ?!
statements.chinese: 我们该怎么办？！

statements.english: I don't know , I don't know
statements.chinese: 我不知道，我不知道。

statements.english: All right well , we're just gonna have to tell Monica , that's all
statements.chinese: 好吧，看来我们只能告诉Monica了，就这样吧。

statements.english: Oh gosh , she's going to kill me
statements.chinese: 天哪，她会杀了我的。

statements.english: I suppose I could tell her it's just all my fault
statements.chinese: 我想我可以说这全是我的错。

statements.english: Ohh that'd be great !
statements.chinese: 哦，那太好了！

statements.english: Mon , can I talk to you for a sec ?
statements.chinese: 妈，我能跟你聊会儿吗？

statements.english: Yeah , what is it ?
statements.chinese: 嗯，什么事？

statements.english: Umm , I lost one of your earrings
statements.chinese: 呃，我弄丢了你的一只耳环。

statements.english: I'm sorry ! I am so , so sorry !
statements.chinese: 对不起！我真的很抱歉！

statements.english: All right well , I mean , what can you do ? If you lost it you lost it
statements.chinese: 好吧，我是说，你还能怎么办呢？丢了就是丢了。

statements.english: I will replace it , I promise . I feel so terrible
statements.chinese: 我会把它换掉的，我保证。我真的很抱歉。

statements.english: All right , sweetie that's fine . You didn't do it on purpose
statements.chinese: 好了，宝贝，没关系。你不是故意的。

statements.english: No
statements.chinese: No.

statements.english: Look at you ! Come here !
statements.chinese: 看看你！快过来！

statements.english: Feel better ?
statements.chinese: 感觉好些了吗？

statements.english: Yeah ! You're the best !
statements.chinese: 太棒了！你是最棒的！

statements.english: Okay , wait a minute
statements.chinese: 好的，稍等一下。

statements.english: Wait a minute , I-I-I , I can't do this
statements.chinese: 等一下，我、我、我，我做不到。

statements.english: Listen honey , this is , it's not Phoebe's fault
statements.chinese: 听着亲爱的，这不是Phoebe的错。

statements.english: She lent me the earrings , and I lost it
statements.chinese: 她把耳环借给我，我却弄丢了。

statements.english: I'm so sorry . Honey , I feel terrible too
statements.chinese: 非常抱歉。亲爱的，我也很难过。

statements.english: That is exactly why I do not lend you stuff !! Okay ?!
statements.chinese: 这就是为什么我不借你东西的原因！！懂了吗？！

statements.english: I mean , first it's my jewelry !
statements.chinese: 我是说，首先那是我的珠宝！

statements.english: And if it's not my jewelry , it's-it's my blue sweater !
statements.chinese: 要不是我的珠宝，就是——就是我的蓝色毛衣！

statements.english: And if it's not my sweater , it's my sunglasses !
statements.chinese: 要不是我的毛衣不见了，就是我的太阳镜找不着了！

statements.english: Your sunglasses ?!
statements.chinese: 你的太阳镜？！
